title: Two-factor authentication
lead: Confirm that it’s you with your second factor.

key.unusable: Your security key cannot be used in this browser on this page: it needs a secure connection (https://).

code.hint: The {length}-digit code the app shows right now.

expired.title: Sign-in expired
expired.detail: The time for the second step ran out. Sign in again.

recovery.title: Use a recovery code
recovery.lead: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication. Each code works once.
recovery.hint: {length} characters, in three groups as on your list. Lower case is fine; you can paste the whole code.

enrolment.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enrolment.lead: This Hexmark installation requires a second factor for every account. Set one up to finish signing in.
enrolment.choose: Choose what to use as your second factor:

none.title: No second factor available
none.detail: Your account has no second factor that can be used here, and no recovery codes left. Contact your administrator to regain access.

keyOnly.title: Security key not usable here
keyOnly.detail: Your account can only be confirmed with a security key, which this browser cannot use on this page (it needs a secure connection, https://). Open Hexmark at its https:// address, or contact your administrator.

enrolment.title: No second factor can be set up here
enrolment.detail: This installation requires a second factor, but none can be set up in this browser on this page. Contact your administrator.
